# smc_multi_contact_mvia (Resource)

This represents a list of multi contact address elements, which are used to manage multiple contact addresses in the system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from_ref` (String) parent href of this sub-resource
- `id` (String) this attribute is the identifier of terraform resource
- `multi_contact_addresses` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--multi_contact_addresses))

<a id="nestedblock--multi_contact_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_contact_addresses`

Optional:

- `addresses` (List of String) A list of IP addresses associated with the multi contact address element. This field is required if the multi contact address element is enabled.
- `location_ref` (String) This represents the definition of a Location, which keeps a list of Network Elements belonging to the same location.
